title: Update runtime Mermaid to address reachable diagram rendering advisories
outcome: Upgrade Mermaid to the smallest compatible patched release (at least11.16.1 for the current nine Mermaid GHSAs), deliberately resolve its runtime sanitizer dependencies, and verify main-realm untrusted-diagram rendering through a separate reviewed, gated change. No blanket npm audit fix or unreviewed UI deployment.
acceptance: ui/package-lock.json resolves Mermaid 11.16.1 within the unchanged manifest range; the nine directly reported Mermaid advisories no longer apply, and normal ESM/fallback DOMPurify copies plus remaining advisories are explicitly recorded.
Relevant Mermaid/Markdown Vitest controls and TypeScript checking pass without changing runtime rendering or trust settings.
The full maintained gate passes on the final input, and an independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
